name: Popover
summary: A card that floats next to a trigger and holds more than a note: a heading, a body and a row of actions. The trigger is a <summary>, so the card opens and closes with the browser's own disclosure behaviour.
summaryZh: 浮在触发器旁边的一块卡片,比一句提示能装的东西多:一个标题、一段正文和一排操作。触发器是 <summary>,所以卡片的开关由浏览器自己的展开行为负责。

variants.name: Above the trigger
variants.note: The card opens above the trigger instead of below it.

variants.name: Left of the trigger
variants.note: The card opens to the left of the trigger.

variants.name: Right of the trigger
variants.note: The card opens to the right of the trigger.

sizes.name: Small
sizes.note: A narrow card. The width is a measure of the card's own type, so it grows with the mood's text.

sizes.name: Medium
sizes.note: The default card. The base class is already this width, so it needs no modifier.

sizes.name: Large
sizes.note: A wide card, for a body of text rather than a line of it.

states.name: Open
states.note: The trigger's <details> is open, so the card is shown.

states.name: Disabled
states.note: The popover is not asked for, so the card never opens.

states.name: Not enterable
states.note: The pointer cannot enter the card: the words in it cannot be selected and the pointer passes straight through it.

parts.name: Trigger
parts.note: The <summary> that opens the card. Its marker is a shape drawn from two borders.

parts.name: Content
parts.note: The floating card. It sits on the overlay surface and carries its own shadow, because it is above the page rather than on it.

parts.name: Header
parts.note: The heading of the card. It is separated from the body by a rule.

parts.name: Body
parts.note: The text of the card. The body is optional — a card can hold a header and a footer alone.

parts.name: Footer
parts.note: The row at the bottom of the card, usually the actions.

props.name: placement
props.description: Where the card opens relative to the trigger. The bottom placement is the base class on its own; the other three add um-popover--top, um-popover--left or um-popover--right.
props.descriptionZh: 卡片相对触发器从哪里打开。bottom 就是只写基础类;另外三个分别加上 um-popover--top、um-popover--left、um-popover--right。

props.name: width
props.description: How wide the card is. The measures are in the card's own type, so the card grows with the mood's text instead of holding a fixed pixel width.
props.descriptionZh: 卡片有多宽。这几档用的是卡片自己的字号单位,所以卡片会跟着 mood 的文字一起变大,而不是卡在一个固定的像素宽度上。

props.name: title
props.description: The heading of the card. It is a real heading element, not a bold paragraph, so the reader can jump to it.
props.descriptionZh: 卡片的标题。它是一个真正的标题元素,不是加粗的段落,读者可以跳到它。

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the popover is switched off. A disabled popover never opens. It adds um-popover--disabled.
props.descriptionZh: 浮层是否关闭。关闭的浮层不会打开。它加上 um-popover--disabled。

props.name: enterable
props.description: Whether the pointer can enter the card. A card that cannot be entered lets the pointer through it, so the words in it cannot be selected. It adds um-popover--not-enterable.
props.descriptionZh: 指针能否进入卡片。不可进入的卡片会让指针穿过去,里面的字也就选不中。它加上 um-popover--not-enterable。

props.name: visible
props.description: Whether the card is open. It is the open attribute on the trigger's own <details>.
props.descriptionZh: 卡片是否展开。就是触发器那个 <details> 上的 open 属性。

slots.name: footer
slots.description: The row at the bottom of the card.

slots.name: reference
slots.description: The element that opens the card. This is Element Plus's name for the trigger; either one of them fills it.
slots.descriptionZh: 打开卡片的元素。这是 Element Plus 对触发器的叫法,两个都能填满它。

events.name: toggle
events.description: Fires when the card opens or closes. It is the browser's own event on the <details> — the library installs no listener.
events.descriptionZh: 卡片打开或关闭时触发。这是 <details> 上的浏览器原生事件 —— 库没有安装任何监听器。

a11y.notes: The trigger is a <summary>, so the browser announces it as a disclosure button and says whether the card is open. The card is not modal: it does not trap the focus, and whatever is inside it is an ordinary focusable element. Escape does not close it — a CSS-only library has no key handling to add — so the reader closes it with the same trigger they opened it with. Put the heading in a real heading element, so the reader can navigate by it.
a11y.notesZh: 触发器是 <summary>,浏览器会把它当作展开按钮播报,并说明卡片是开着还是关着。这张卡片不是模态的:它不困住焦点,里面的东西就是普通的可聚焦元素。Escape 关不掉它 —— 纯 CSS 的库没有键位处理可加 —— 所以读者用打开它的那个触发器把它关掉。标题要放在真正的标题元素里,读者才能靠它跳转。

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: A card with a heading, a body and a row of actions. The trigger opens it; the browser owns the open state.
examples.descriptionZh: 一张带标题、正文和一排操作的卡片。触发器负责打开,打开状态由浏览器自己管。
examples.markup:

examples.title: Without a footer
examples.description: The footer is optional. Without it the card is a heading and a paragraph, and the body keeps its own padding.
examples.descriptionZh: 底部是可选的。没有它,卡片就是一个标题加一段话,正文仍然保留自己的内边距。
examples.markup:

examples.title: Placements
examples.description: The base class opens the card below the trigger. The three modifiers open it above, to the left or to the right.
examples.descriptionZh: 基础类把卡片开在触发器下面。三个修饰类把它开在上面、左边或右边。
examples.markup:
Above
The card opens above the trigger.
Left
The card opens to the left of the trigger.
Right
The card opens to the right of the trigger.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: Three widths. The middle one is the base class on its own, because the base class is already the medium card.
examples.descriptionZh: 三种宽度。中间那个只写基础类,因为基础类本来就是中号卡片。
examples.markup:
Small
A narrow card.
Medium
The default card.
Large
A wide card.

notes: The card is hidden with `display: none` and shown again by `[open]`, rather than left to the browser's rendering of a closed <details>. The browser hides a closed details with a slot, which is not guaranteed to catch a child that has been taken out of the flow — and this card is absolutely positioned, so it has been. Two lines of CSS buy a guarantee that the closed card is really gone.
notesZh: 卡片是用 `display: none` 藏起来的,再由 `[open]` 放出来,而不是交给浏览器对关闭状态下的 <details> 的渲染。浏览器用一个 slot 来藏关闭的 details,这个做法不保证能盖住被拿出文档流的子元素 —— 而这张卡片正是绝对定位的,也就是被拿出了文档流。多写两行 CSS,换来的是"关着的卡片真的不在了"这个保证。
